canonical_name: KW Wealth Club (local chapter of KW Wealth)
summary: A monthly evening 'Learning Lab with Happy Hour Following' at Keller Williams Professionals' Asheville office (48 Grove St), run as the local chapter of Keller Williams' national 'KW Wealth' program on real estate finance, investing, and wealth building. It is brokerage-run and agent-focused but listings describe it as also open to 'local wealth builders,' investors, and homeowners, with a consistent recurring format and venue pairing education with networking/happy hour, closer to a networking chapter than a one-off commercial class.

evidence.note: Eventbrite listing describes it as a 'Learning Lab with Happy Hour Following,' 2 hours, at 48 Grove Street, organized by Keller Williams Professionals, part of a recurring 'Tough Money Series.'

7 listings run monthly (median gap 35 days) from 2026-01-02 through 2026-10-02, always free, always at the same Keller Williams office address, with consistent seminar+networking framing across summaries.
September listing calls it 'a business-forward meetup format with time for questions and local networking,' aimed at 'investors and homeowners,' not just KW agents.

KW Wealth is Keller Williams' national program/community 'where agents, investors, and leaders come together to learn, connect, and build wealth side by side,' with weekly live classes, a private community platform, and live mastermind events; this Asheville listing appears to be a local chapter/meetup version of that program rather than a standalone independent club.

No dedicated Asheville-specific 'KW Wealth Club' website, Facebook group, or Meetup page was found; only the national KW Wealth program page and the local KW Professionals brokerage's own social pages turned up in search.
